players.product: Large-scale water treatment systems for semiconductor makers, plus maintenance, consumables and piping materials for semiconductor manufacturing equipment

quarterly_data.quarter: Nomura Micro Science TDnet: Revisions to the Consolidated Earnings Forecast for the (10-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Forecast revision (FY ending March 2027): the interim (April-September 2026) forecast was cut to sales revenue JPY 24,180 million (from JPY 34,500 million), operating profit JPY 1,132 million (from JPY 3,600 million), 'operating income' JPY (141) million (from JPY 2,650 million) and interim net income attributable to parent shareholders JPY (91) million, because orders for large water treatment systems projects in the United States expected in the first half are now expected in the second half, and costs rose on large water treatment projects already ordered in South Korea. The full-year forecast keeps sales revenue JPY 97,000 million and operating profit JPY 16,000 million, citing strong inquiries in each region and progress-based sales of the U.S. projects in the second half, but cuts 'operating income' to JPY 14,000 million (from JPY 15,000 million) and net income to JPY 10,360 million (from JPY 11,100 million) after reviewing interest paid on borrowings.
quarterly_data.figure: FY3/2027 sales JPY 97,000 million and operating profit JPY 16,000 million unchanged; interim sales cut to JPY 24,180 million from JPY 34,500 million
